title: PRESSER | Jada Richard & Doneelah Washington - Alabama A&M Postgame (11-22-26)
text: Rishard, career-high 22 point performance today. How did you feel about your performance? >> Um, I think it was all right. I think my teammates um they just found me. They knew I was hot. Um, and I was just able to knock it down. Just a testament to me being in the gym and hitting shots. Um, but honestly, I'm not I'm not um I'm not what's the word? I'm not really happy about it, honestly. But we got the win, so that's all that matters. >> And you have a first half that's as close as it was. You come out and you end up winning by a pretty decent margin. What does that say about this team, especially early on with all the new faces? >> Um, I think definitely we have to get off to a quicker start. Um, but obviously, like you said, it's a lot of new players, a lot of new faces. So, that just comes with just building chemistry. Um, and just playing together, but I think in the second half we kind of picked it up um and got on the board. So, >> with 500 career guys, how how's that feel? What are the emotions like? >> I'm proud of myself. [laughter] No, but honestly, I'm proud of myself. But um honestly, it's just like going out there and trying to help my team like win a game. So, a lot of those secondhand opportunities like come are useful. >> Man, Coach O been on her about rebounding. >> She been on me a little bit. So, getting out there and doing that was I'm proud of myself today. >> Speaking of coach, what was the message at halftime from her um to push y'all to try to extend the lead of this game? >> Yeah. Um she basically just said we weren't doing what we were supposed to be doing. um we knew what we had to do offensively defensively and we just we were missing assignments. Um we weren't really executing the scout report. So just knowing that it wasn't really anything they was doing. It's kind of on us and what we was doing. Um and yeah, to just come out and do what we do and do what we practice. So >> in kind of a chippy game, especially near the end there, how do you kind of keep yourself levelheaded and not let your emotions take over? >> Um I mean I think we play with passion, they play with passion. Um I think it's great for women's basketball, but just keeping it about basketball. Um obviously like you being competitive in the moment like you get a jump ball obviously you don't want to let the ball go. Um but it just comes with a sense of maturity. Um just understanding that we competing but at the end of the day it's just basketball. So >> what can you take from today and how can you guys apply it to the rest of the season? What or I guess what lessons have you guys learned? >> Honestly just like not playing down to a certain team's levels. Also we need a better start at the beginning of the games. Danila, six games in. How are you fitting in to the the Old Miss sway and the Old Miss standard? >> I'm still getting used to it. We just we just at the beginning, but yeah, they they push me every day, my team, my coaches. So, >> Jane, I know it's again still super early, but how do you feel like you're connecting with your with your teammates, especially as PG-1 because I know Coach, she's on her PGs like each and every day. So, how do you feel like you're you're connecting with everybody? >> Um, I mean, I feel like I'm doing a a decent job. Obviously, I can get better, but I'm obviously still a work in progress. Um, I try to be the best I can be, um, from a person and just as a leader just for them because I know that they kind of look to me for that energy. Um, but I mean, I'm not there yet and they help me and they understand that I'm not there yet. So, they just bear with me. Um, Coach O bears with me. Uh, she's hard on me, but it's all a lot of love. So, >> is that it for questions? New
